plugin.name: Fathom
plugin.description: Fathom meetings as activity items: a new-meeting webhook trigger, meetings since a time, summaries, action items and opt-in transcripts, teams and users
plugin.author: Landflow

nodes.name: fathom
nodes.description: Read Fathom meetings (summary, action items, opt-in transcript) as activity items, plus teams, team members and users
nodes.subtitle: {{resource}}: {{operation}}

options.name: Get Transcript
options.description: The transcript of one recording (needs Include Transcript on)

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Members of your teams, with their email addresses

options.name: Get Many
options.description: The account's users (admin API keys only)

options.name: Get
options.description: One meeting as an activity item, with its text (summary, action items, transcript only on request). Fathom has no get-by-id endpoint: the meeting is found in the list.

source.description: The tool, lowercase: slack, google-drive, google-calendar, notion, …

sourceId.description: Stable id of the change, '<source>:<tool ids>': the same change always has the same id, so a replay is recognised

actorEmail.description: Email of the person who made the change, lowercase; null when the tool doesn't say

occurredAt.description: When it happened, ISO 8601 in UTC with milliseconds

kind.description: Suggested event kind, such as work.discussion or work.doc_edited; a flow may change it

title.description: One line: the document, ticket or meeting title, or the channel and first words

summary.description: The text, whitespace collapsed, at most 600 characters

teamHint.description: The team it seems to belong to, from the tool's own grouping, when there is one

initiativeHint.description: The project or initiative it seems to belong to, when there is one

customerHint.description: The customer it is about, when there is one (a #customer-<name> channel, a CRM company…)

raw.description: The tool's own object, trimmed: long strings clipped, long lists cut, deep nesting dropped

cursor.description: Pass it back as Since to continue after this item (List Changed Since operations)

text.description: Summary, action items and (with Include Transcript) the transcript

properties.name: recordingId
properties.description: The meeting's recording_id (the number in fathom:meeting:<id>)

properties.name: includeTranscript
properties.description: Transcripts are private by default: turn this on to read it

properties.name: since
properties.description: Meetings created after this ISO time or a cursor from an earlier item. Empty: the last 24 hours.

values.name: includeTranscript
values.description: Whether the transcript is read and added (to Get's text and to raw). Off by default: transcripts are private and Fathom rate-limits them harder.

values.name: includeSummary
values.description: Whether summaries are read (they count as heavy calls: 30 a minute)

values.name: recordedBy
values.description: Only meetings recorded by these emails (comma-separated)

values.name: teams
values.description: Only meetings of these teams (comma-separated names)

values.name: createdBefore
values.description: Only meetings created before this ISO time (Get: narrows the search)

values.name: internalDomains
values.description: Email domains that are your own. The customerHint is the first invitee outside them. Empty: the recorder's own domain.

values.name: actionItemItems
values.displayName: Also Output One Item per Action Item
values.description: Whether each action item becomes its own activity item (kind work.action_item, assignee as actorEmail) after its meeting's item

properties.name: teamName
properties.description: Only members of this team (name). Empty: all.

nodes.name: fathomTrigger
nodes.description: Starts the workflow when a Fathom meeting's content is ready, with the meeting (and optionally its action items) as activity items

properties.name: notice
properties.displayName: Fathom's API registers the webhook for you: publishing the workflow creates it (the signing secret is kept for you) and unpublishing deletes it. Landflow must be reachable from the internet at the published URL. Transcripts stay out unless Include Transcript is on.

values.name: includeTranscript
values.description: Whether the transcript is requested from Fathom and added to each item's raw data. Off by default: transcripts are private.

values.name: internalDomains
values.description: Email domains that are your own. The customerHint is the first invitee outside them. Empty: the recorder's own domain.

values.name: actionItemItems
values.displayName: Also Output One Item per Action Item
values.description: Whether each action item becomes its own activity item (kind work.action_item, assignee as actorEmail) after its meeting's item

values.name: tolerance
values.description: How far the signed webhook-timestamp may be from now before the call is rejected as a replay

credentialTypes.name: fathomApi
credentialTypes.description: An API key from Fathom (Settings → API Access), sent as the X-Api-Key header. Fathom also offers OAuth for public apps, but publishes no authorize URL, so there is no OAuth2 credential here. The key sees your own meetings and those shared with you.

properties.name: apiKey
properties.description: Created in Fathom under Settings → API Access

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.description: Change it only for a proxy or a test double
